question: P, Q, R, S, T, U and V live on seven different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it is number 2, and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 7. Q lives on floor number 2. R lives on the floor immediately above U's floor. S is on the floor immediately below V's floor. Only three persons live between the floors of T and P. R lives on the topmost floor. Only one person lives between the floors of R and P. On which floor does P live?
solution:
Given: P, Q, R, S, T, U and V live on seven different floors of the same building.

The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it is number 2, and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 7.

1) Q lives on floor number 2.

2) R lives on the topmost floor.
